def tryfam(name,fn,grid):
    b=(9,None,None)
    for p in grid:
        Ftr=fn(p)
        if Ftr is None: continue
        A=np.column_stack(Ftr)
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
        r=np.mean((A@c-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma)
        if r<b[0]: b=(r,p,c.round(3))
    print(name,b)
